name: A1 - Equinet Discovery Orchestrator - Directories and Google Maps-v2

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS a1_runs (
  run_id text PRIMARY KEY,
  status text NOT NULL,
  segment text NOT NULL,
  location jsonb NOT NULL,
  location_key text,
  source_scope_key text,
  focus jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  requested_count integer NOT NULL,
  discovery_target integer NOT NULL,
  unique_leads_found integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  source_policy_version text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE a1_runs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS location_key text;
ALTER TABLE a1_runs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_scope_key text;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS a1_source_state (
  run_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES a1_runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  source_id text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  cursor jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  records_returned integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_error text,
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, source_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS a1_source_cursors (
  source_scope_key text NOT NULL,
  segment text NOT NULL,
  location_key text NOT NULL,
  source_id text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  cursor jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  records_returned integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_run_id text,
  last_error text,
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (source_scope_key, source_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS a1_raw_leads (
  run_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES a1_runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  lead_fingerprint text NOT NULL,
  payload jsonb NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'discovered',
  hubspot_match jsonb,
  hubspot_checked_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, lead_fingerprint)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS a1_lead_sources (
  run_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES a1_runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  lead_fingerprint text NOT NULL,
  source_id text NOT NULL,
  source_record_id text NOT NULL,
  source_url text,
  payload jsonb NOT NULL,
  discovered_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, lead_fingerprint, source_id, source_record_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS a1_lead_ledger (
  lead_fingerprint text PRIMARY KEY,
  canonical_payload jsonb NOT NULL,
  first_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  last_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS a1_lead_identity_keys (
  identity_key text PRIMARY KEY,
  lead_fingerprint text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS a1_lead_identity_fingerprint_idx
  ON a1_lead_identity_keys(lead_fingerprint);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS a1_source_consumed_records (
  source_scope_key text NOT NULL,
  source_id text NOT NULL,
  source_record_id text NOT NULL,
  lead_fingerprint text NOT NULL,
  first_seen_run_id text NOT NULL,
  first_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  last_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (source_scope_key, source_id, source_record_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS
  a1_source_consumed_fingerprint_idx
ON a1_source_consumed_records (
  lead_fingerprint
);

INSERT INTO a1_lead_identity_keys (identity_key, lead_fingerprint)
SELECT lead_fingerprint, lead_fingerprint
FROM a1_lead_ledger
ON CONFLICT (identity_key) DO NOTHING;

SELECT 1 AS schema_ready;

WITH attempted AS (
  INSERT INTO a1_runs (
    run_id,
    status,
    segment,
    location,
    location_key,
    source_scope_key,
    focus,
    requested_count,
    discovery_target,
    source_policy_version,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    $1,
    'discovering',
    $2,
    $3::jsonb,
    $4,
    $5,
    $6::jsonb,
    $7,
    $8,
    $9,
    now(),
    now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (run_id)
  DO NOTHING
  RETURNING *
),
stored AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM attempted

  UNION ALL

  SELECT existing.*
  FROM a1_runs existing
  WHERE existing.run_id = $1

  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  stored.*,

  (
    stored.segment = $2
    AND stored.location_key = $4
    AND stored.source_scope_key = $5
    AND stored.focus = $6::jsonb
    AND stored.requested_count = $7
    AND stored.discovery_target = $8
    AND stored.source_policy_version = $9
  ) AS resume_scope_valid,

  jsonb_build_object(
    'stored_segment',
      stored.segment,
    'requested_segment',
      $2,

    'stored_location_key',
      stored.location_key,
    'requested_location_key',
      $4,

    'stored_source_scope_key',
      stored.source_scope_key,
    'requested_source_scope_key',
      $5,

    'stored_requested_count',
      stored.requested_count,
    'requested_requested_count',
      $7,

    'stored_discovery_target',
      stored.discovery_target,
    'requested_discovery_target',
      $8,

    'stored_source_policy_version',
      stored.source_policy_version,
    'requested_source_policy_version',
      $9
  ) AS resume_scope_comparison

FROM stored;

SELECT
  r.run_id,
  r.status AS run_status,
  r.segment,
  r.location,
  r.location_key,
  r.source_scope_key,
  r.focus,
  r.requested_count,
  r.discovery_target,
  r.unique_leads_found,
  r.source_policy_version,
  $2::text AS source_id,
  $3::text AS source_name,
  $4::text AS source_type,
  $5::integer AS source_order,
  $6::jsonb AS source_location_config,
  GREATEST(r.discovery_target - r.unique_leads_found, 0) AS max_results,
  COALESCE(c.cursor, '{}'::jsonb) AS cursor,
  COALESCE(c.status, 'pending') AS source_status
FROM a1_runs r
LEFT JOIN a1_source_cursors c
  ON c.source_scope_key = r.source_scope_key
 AND c.source_id = $2
WHERE r.run_id = $1;

WITH RECURSIVE existing_run_count AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::integer AS lead_count
  FROM a1_raw_leads
  WHERE run_id = $1
),
incoming AS (
  SELECT value AS item, ordinality::bigint AS ordinal
  FROM jsonb_array_elements($3::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS rows(value, ordinality)
  WHERE COALESCE(value->>'lead_fingerprint', '') <> ''
),
incoming_keys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    i.ordinal,
    key.value AS identity_key
  FROM incoming i
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(
    CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(i.item->'identity_keys') = 'array'
        THEN i.item->'identity_keys'
      ELSE jsonb_build_array(i.item->>'lead_fingerprint')
    END
  ) AS key(value)
  WHERE COALESCE(key.value, '') <> ''
),

identity_match AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    k.ordinal,
    a.lead_fingerprint
  FROM incoming_keys k
  JOIN a1_lead_identity_keys a
    ON a.identity_key = k.identity_key
),

consumed_match AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    i.ordinal,
    consumed.lead_fingerprint
  FROM incoming i
  JOIN a1_source_consumed_records consumed
    ON consumed.source_scope_key = $11
   AND consumed.source_id = $2
   AND consumed.source_record_id = i.item->>'source_record_id'
  WHERE COALESCE(i.item->>'source_record_id', '') <> ''
),

batch_identity_edges AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    left_key.ordinal AS from_ordinal,
    right_key.ordinal AS to_ordinal
  FROM incoming_keys left_key
  JOIN incoming_keys right_key
    ON right_key.identity_key = left_key.identity_key
),

ordinal_closure (
  root_ordinal,
  member_ordinal
) AS (
  SELECT
    ordinal,
    ordinal
  FROM incoming

  UNION

  SELECT
    closure.root_ordinal,
    edge.to_ordinal
  FROM ordinal_closure closure
  JOIN batch_identity_edges edge
    ON edge.from_ordinal = closure.member_ordinal
),

canonical_candidates AS (
  -- Prefer an existing global alias.
  SELECT
    closure.root_ordinal AS ordinal,
    matched.lead_fingerprint,
    0 AS candidate_priority
  FROM ordinal_closure closure
  JOIN identity_match matched
    ON matched.ordinal = closure.member_ordinal

  UNION ALL

  -- Then prefer an existing consumed-source identity.
  SELECT
    closure.root_ordinal AS ordinal,
    consumed.lead_fingerprint,
    1 AS candidate_priority
  FROM ordinal_closure closure
  JOIN consumed_match consumed
    ON consumed.ordinal = closure.member_ordinal

  UNION ALL

  -- Otherwise choose one stable fingerprint from the connected batch.
  SELECT
    closure.root_ordinal AS ordinal,
    member.item->>'lead_fingerprint' AS lead_fingerprint,
    2 AS candidate_priority
  FROM ordinal_closure closure
  JOIN incoming member
    ON member.ordinal = closure.member_ordinal
),

alias_match AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ordinal)
    ordinal,
    lead_fingerprint
  FROM canonical_candidates
  WHERE COALESCE(lead_fingerprint, '') <> ''
  ORDER BY
    ordinal,
    candidate_priority,
    lead_fingerprint
),
resolved_incoming AS (
  SELECT
    jsonb_set(
      i.item,
      '{lead_fingerprint}',
      to_jsonb(COALESCE(a.lead_fingerprint, i.item->>'lead_fingerprint')),
      true
    ) AS item,
    i.ordinal
  FROM incoming i
  LEFT JOIN alias_match a ON a.ordinal = i.ordinal
),
canonical_incoming AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (item->>'lead_fingerprint') item
  FROM resolved_incoming
  ORDER BY
    item->>'lead_fingerprint',
    (NULLIF(item->>'website', '') IS NOT NULL) DESC,
    (NULLIF(item->>'phone', '') IS NOT NULL) DESC,
    (NULLIF(item->>'address', '') IS NOT NULL) DESC,
    (NULLIF(item->>'business_name', '') IS NOT NULL) DESC,
    ordinal ASC
),
source_incoming AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (
    item->>'lead_fingerprint',
    COALESCE(NULLIF(item->>'source_record_id', ''), item->>'lead_fingerprint')
  ) item
  FROM resolved_incoming
  ORDER BY
    item->>'lead_fingerprint',
    COALESCE(NULLIF(item->>'source_record_id', ''), item->>'lead_fingerprint'),
    ordinal DESC
),
  consumed_source_incoming AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (item->>'source_record_id')
    item
  FROM source_incoming
  WHERE COALESCE(item->>'source_record_id', '') <> ''
  ORDER BY
    item->>'source_record_id',
    item->>'lead_fingerprint'
),
new_global AS (
  INSERT INTO a1_lead_ledger (
    lead_fingerprint, canonical_payload, first_seen_at, last_seen_at
  )
  SELECT item->>'lead_fingerprint', item, now(), now()
  FROM canonical_incoming
  ON CONFLICT (lead_fingerprint) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING lead_fingerprint
),
ledger_refresh AS (
  UPDATE a1_lead_ledger ledger
  SET
    canonical_payload = ledger.canonical_payload || incoming.item,
    last_seen_at = now()
  FROM canonical_incoming incoming
  WHERE ledger.lead_fingerprint = incoming.item->>'lead_fingerprint'
  RETURNING ledger.lead_fingerprint
),
alias_rows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    key.value AS identity_key,
    item.item->>'lead_fingerprint' AS lead_fingerprint
  FROM resolved_incoming item
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(
    CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(item.item->'identity_keys') = 'array'
        THEN item.item->'identity_keys'
      ELSE jsonb_build_array(item.item->>'lead_fingerprint')
    END
  ) AS key(value)
  WHERE
    COALESCE(key.value, '') <> ''
    AND COALESCE(item.item->>'lead_fingerprint', '') <> ''
),

canonical_alias_rows AS (
  SELECT
    identity_key,
    MIN(lead_fingerprint) AS lead_fingerprint
  FROM alias_rows
  GROUP BY identity_key
),

alias_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO a1_lead_identity_keys (
    identity_key,
    lead_fingerprint,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    identity_key,
    lead_fingerprint,
    now(),
    now()
  FROM canonical_alias_rows
  ON CONFLICT (identity_key) DO UPDATE SET
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING identity_key
),
run_lead_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO a1_raw_leads (
    run_id, lead_fingerprint, payload, status, created_at, updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    $1,
    incoming.item->>'lead_fingerprint',
    incoming.item,
    'discovered',
    now(),
    now()
  FROM canonical_incoming incoming
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM new_global n
    WHERE n.lead_fingerprint = incoming.item->>'lead_fingerprint'
  ) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM a1_raw_leads current_run
    WHERE current_run.run_id = $1
      AND current_run.lead_fingerprint = incoming.item->>'lead_fingerprint'
  )
  ON CONFLICT (run_id, lead_fingerprint) DO UPDATE SET
    payload = a1_raw_leads.payload || EXCLUDED.payload,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING lead_fingerprint
),
source_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO a1_lead_sources (
    run_id, lead_fingerprint, source_id, source_record_id,
    source_url, payload, discovered_at
  )
  SELECT
    $1,
    item->>'lead_fingerprint',
    $2,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(item->>'source_record_id', ''), item->>'lead_fingerprint'),
    NULLIF(item->>'source_url', ''),
    item,
    now()
  FROM source_incoming
  ON CONFLICT (run_id, lead_fingerprint, source_id, source_record_id) DO UPDATE SET
    source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url,
    payload = EXCLUDED.payload
  RETURNING lead_fingerprint
),
consumed_source_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO a1_source_consumed_records (
    source_scope_key, source_id, source_record_id, lead_fingerprint,
    first_seen_run_id, first_seen_at, last_seen_at
  )
  SELECT
    $11,
    $2,
    item->>'source_record_id',
    item->>'lead_fingerprint',
    $1,
    now(),
    now()
  FROM consumed_source_incoming
  ON CONFLICT (source_scope_key, source_id, source_record_id) DO UPDATE SET
    last_seen_at = now()
  RETURNING source_record_id
),
run_state_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO a1_source_state (
    run_id, source_id, status, cursor, records_returned, last_error, updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    $1, $2, $4, $5::jsonb, $6, $7, now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (run_id, source_id) DO UPDATE SET
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    cursor = EXCLUDED.cursor,
    records_returned = COALESCE(a1_source_state.records_returned, 0) + EXCLUDED.records_returned,
    last_error = EXCLUDED.last_error,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING source_id
),
global_cursor_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO a1_source_cursors (
    source_scope_key, segment, location_key, source_id, status, cursor,
    records_returned, last_run_id, last_error, updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    $11, $9, $10, $2, $4,
    $5::jsonb,
    $6, $1, $7, now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (source_scope_key, source_id) DO UPDATE SET
    status = CASE
      WHEN EXCLUDED.status IN ('failed', 'blocked')
        THEN a1_source_cursors.status
      ELSE EXCLUDED.status
    END,
    cursor = CASE
      WHEN EXCLUDED.status IN ('failed', 'blocked')
        THEN a1_source_cursors.cursor
      WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'exhausted'
        THEN EXCLUDED.cursor
      ELSE EXCLUDED.cursor
    END,
    records_returned = COALESCE(a1_source_cursors.records_returned, 0) + EXCLUDED.records_returned,
    last_run_id = EXCLUDED.last_run_id,
    last_error = EXCLUDED.last_error,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING source_id
),
updated_run AS (
  UPDATE a1_runs
  SET
    unique_leads_found =
  (
    SELECT lead_count
    FROM existing_run_count
  )
  +
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*)::integer
    FROM new_global
  ),
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE run_id = $1
  RETURNING run_id, status, requested_count, discovery_target, unique_leads_found
)
SELECT
  updated_run.*,
  $2::text AS source_id,
  $4::text AS source_status,
  $6::integer AS records_returned,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM new_global)::integer AS globally_new_records
FROM updated_run;

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::integer AS discovered_count,
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE status = 'eligible'
    ))::integer AS eligible_count,
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE status = 'possible_duplicate'
    ))::integer AS possible_duplicate_count,
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE status = 'hubspot_duplicate'
    ))::integer AS duplicate_count,
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE status = 'hubspot_check_failed'
    ))::integer AS failure_count
  FROM a1_raw_leads
  WHERE run_id = $1
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE a1_runs r
  SET
    status = CASE
      WHEN c.eligible_count >= r.requested_count
        THEN 'discovery_complete'
      WHEN c.discovered_count > 0
        THEN 'discovery_partial'
      ELSE 'discovery_failed'
    END,
    unique_leads_found = c.discovered_count,
    updated_at = now()
  FROM counts c
  WHERE r.run_id = $1
  RETURNING r.*
)
SELECT
  u.run_id,
  u.status,
  c.discovered_count,
  c.eligible_count,
  c.possible_duplicate_count,
  c.duplicate_count,
  c.failure_count
FROM updated u
CROSS JOIN counts c;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    run_id,
    lead_fingerprint,
    payload,
    false AS control_only
  FROM a1_raw_leads
  WHERE run_id = $1
    AND status IN ('discovered', 'hubspot_check_failed')
  ORDER BY lead_fingerprint
)
SELECT *
FROM candidates

UNION ALL

SELECT
  $1::text AS run_id,
  NULL::text AS lead_fingerprint,
  '{}'::jsonb AS payload,
  true AS control_only
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidates);

UPDATE a1_raw_leads
SET
  status = $3,
  hubspot_match = $4::jsonb,
  hubspot_checked_at = now(),
  updated_at = now()
WHERE run_id = $1
  AND lead_fingerprint = $2
RETURNING
  run_id,
  lead_fingerprint,
  status,
  hubspot_match,
  hubspot_checked_at;

WITH run_row AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM a1_runs
  WHERE run_id = $1
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::integer AS discovered_unique_count,

    (COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE status = 'eligible'
    ))::integer AS eligible_count,

    (COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE status = 'possible_duplicate'
    ))::integer AS possible_duplicate_count,

    (COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE status = 'hubspot_duplicate'
    ))::integer AS hubspot_duplicate_count,

    (COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE status = 'hubspot_check_failed'
    ))::integer AS hubspot_failure_count,

    (COUNT(*) FILTER (
  WHERE CASE
    WHEN hubspot_match ? 'domain_available'
      THEN (hubspot_match->>'domain_available')::boolean

    /* Backward compatibility for older run rows. */
    WHEN hubspot_match->>'status' = 'not_checked_no_domain'
      THEN false

    ELSE COALESCE(
      BTRIM(payload->>'website'),
      ''
    ) <> ''
  END = false
))::integer AS no_domain_count,

(COUNT(*) FILTER (
  WHERE hubspot_match->>'search_method' =
    'contact_name_query_exact_postfilter'
))::integer AS contact_name_check_count,

(COUNT(*) FILTER (
  WHERE hubspot_match->>'status' =
    'not_checked_no_lookup_key'
))::integer AS no_lookup_key_count,

(COUNT(*) FILTER (
  WHERE hubspot_match->>'status' = 'possible_match'
    AND hubspot_match->>'object_type' = 'contact'
))::integer AS contact_name_possible_match_count

  FROM a1_raw_leads
  WHERE run_id = $1
),
selected_leads AS (
  SELECT l.*
  FROM a1_raw_leads l
  CROSS JOIN run_row r
  WHERE l.run_id = $1
AND l.status IN (
  'eligible',
  'possible_duplicate',
  'hubspot_check_failed'
)
  ORDER BY
    CASE
  WHEN l.status = 'eligible' THEN 0
  WHEN l.status = 'possible_duplicate' THEN 1
  ELSE 2
END,
    l.created_at,
    l.lead_fingerprint
  LIMIT (SELECT requested_count FROM run_row)
),
lead_result AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_strip_nulls(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'lead_fingerprint', l.lead_fingerprint,
          'status', l.status,
          'business_name',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'business_name', ''),
          'name',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'name', ''),
          'website',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'website', ''),
          'phone',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'phone', ''),
           'email',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'email', ''),
          'address',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'address', ''),
          'city',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'city', ''),
           'region',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'region', ''),
           'region_code',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'region_code', ''),
          'state',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'state', ''),
           'state_code',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'state_code', ''),
          'postal_code',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'postal_code', ''),
          'country',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'country', ''),
          'country_code',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'country_code', ''),
          'google_place_id',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'google_place_id', ''),
          'segment_hint',
            NULLIF(l.payload->>'segment_hint', ''),
          'hubspot_check',
            l.hubspot_match,
          'source_ids',
            COALESCE((
              SELECT jsonb_agg(
                DISTINCT s.source_id
                ORDER BY s.source_id
              )
              FROM a1_lead_sources s
              WHERE s.run_id = l.run_id
                AND s.lead_fingerprint = l.lead_fingerprint
            ), '[]'::jsonb),
          'source_urls',
            COALESCE((
              SELECT jsonb_agg(
                DISTINCT s.source_url
                ORDER BY s.source_url
              )
              FILTER (WHERE s.source_url IS NOT NULL)
              FROM a1_lead_sources s
              WHERE s.run_id = l.run_id
                AND s.lead_fingerprint = l.lead_fingerprint
            ), '[]'::jsonb)
        )
      )
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN l.status = 'eligible' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        l.created_at,
        l.lead_fingerprint
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS leads
  FROM selected_leads l
),
source_result AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_strip_nulls(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'source_id', s.source_id,
          'status', s.status,
          'records_returned', s.records_returned,
          'cursor', s.cursor,
          'error', s.last_error
        )
      )
      ORDER BY s.source_id
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS sources
  FROM a1_source_state s
  WHERE s.run_id = $1
),
warning_result AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(
    array_remove(
      ARRAY[
        CASE
          WHEN c.hubspot_failure_count > 0
          THEN format(
            '%s candidate(s) could not be checked against HubSpot.',
            c.hubspot_failure_count
          )
        END,
        CASE
          WHEN c.no_domain_count > 0
          THEN format(
            '%s candidate(s) had no company domain and received only a partial HubSpot check.',
            c.no_domain_count
          )
        END,
        CASE
          WHEN c.possible_duplicate_count > 0
          THEN format(
            '%s possible duplicate(s) require manual review.',
            c.possible_duplicate_count
          )
        END
      ]::text[],
      NULL
    )
  ) AS warnings
  FROM counts c
)
SELECT
  'a1.discovery-result.v1' AS contract_version,
  r.run_id,
  r.status,

  jsonb_build_object(
  'segment',
    r.segment,

  'location',
    r.location,

  'location_key',
    r.location_key,

  'source_scope_key',
    r.source_scope_key,

  'requested_count',
    r.requested_count,

  'discovery_target',
    r.discovery_target
) AS request,

  jsonb_build_object(
    'registry_id', 'equinet-a1-approved-source-register',
    'registry_version', r.source_policy_version
  ) AS source_policy,

  jsonb_build_object(
    'discovered_unique', c.discovered_unique_count,
    'eligible', c.eligible_count,
    'returned', jsonb_array_length(l.leads),
    'hubspot_duplicates_removed', c.hubspot_duplicate_count,
    'possible_duplicates', c.possible_duplicate_count,
    'hubspot_check_failures', c.hubspot_failure_count,
    'without_domain', c.no_domain_count,
'contact_name_checks',
  c.contact_name_check_count,

'contact_name_possible_matches',
  c.contact_name_possible_match_count,

'without_hubspot_lookup_key',
  c.no_lookup_key_count
  ) AS summary,

  l.leads,
  s.sources,
  w.warnings,

  r.created_at AS started_at,
  r.updated_at AS finished_at

FROM run_row r
CROSS JOIN counts c
CROSS JOIN lead_result l
CROSS JOIN source_result s
CROSS JOIN warning_result w;
